fields.Site/Development Restrictions Descriptio: Zoning MM (Mixto Moderado); max lot coverage 0.70; max FAR 1.80; proposed FAR 1.80; historic street façade preservation; mixed hotel + condo program with shared parking and separate rooftop amenities.

fields.Target Guest Segment Other: Leisure travelers and longer-stay guests seeking authentic centro base; adventure-oriented tourism (surf, ocean, desert, East Cape); second-home condo buyers
fields.Brand Flexibility vs Prestige: Experiential placemaking and community integration over resort-scale amenities
fields.Preferred Third-Party Operators (names): Open — operator must understand branded residence + hotel dual product and condo rental program flexibility
fields.Legal Support Needed?: Yes — Connect me With a Legal Advisor
fields.Company Executive Summary: A boutique hospitality-led mixed-use project in historic San José del Cabo combining a ~52-key urban hotel, 36 branded residences, ground-floor destination F&B, and shared underground parking.
fields.Entity or Company Name: North Blue Ventures LLC d/b/a Altiplano
fields.Key Milestones / Target Dates: Conceptual design M1–4; anteproyecto M5–8; design development + residential sales + hotel operator selection M9–12; construction documents M13–18; construction M19–42; target operations start Jan 2030; stabilization ~Oct 2030.
fields.Architect (if known): Preliminary architectural program in deck — architect TBD
fields.Other Operator Criteria or Notes: Operator must differentiate condo offering from hotel keys, support flexible rental participation for owners, and align with adventure/lifestyle positioning. F&B may be third-party leased.
fields.Additional Notes or Unique Project Aspec: Dual street frontage (Blvd Mijares retail activation + Ave Centenario vehicular access). Adaptive reuse of existing façade. 36 branded residences (avg 72 m²/unit). Condo presale comps: 1BR ~$330K ($5,500/m²), 2BR ~$429K ($5,100/m²). Hotel proforma: 52 keys, untrended ADR $250, 3% growth, stabilized occupancy 68%, Year 3 NOI margin ~38%. Construction methods: post-tensioned flat slabs, CLT explored for rooftop pergola.
fields.Anything else you'd like to add?: Restaurant structured as independently operable venue integrated with hotel but leaseable to dedicated operator. Asset manager role envisioned for condo association capital programs.
